texts.arguments: 2. At the very outset, learned counsel for the petitioner contends that in view of the concurrent findings of both the Courts below, he does not want to challenge the conviction of the petitioner. However, he submits that in view of the circumstances of the case, the sentence awarded by the Courts below is on higher side.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. At the very outset, learned counsel for the petitioner contends that in view of the concurrent findings of both the Courts below, he does not want to challenge the conviction of the petitioner.
